exceptions.reason: Aztec 6.0.0-rc.4 pins OpenTelemetry 1.30.1. The presto does not configure the Jaeger propagator or parse attacker-supplied Jaeger headers.
exceptions.upgrade: Remove when the pinned Aztec release carries OpenTelemetry 2.9.0 or newer.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists. It is reached only through chokidar 3 under Mocha 10, the WebdriverIO desktop test runner, which expands repository-controlled patterns.
exceptions.upgrade: Remove when braces publishes a fix or the WebdriverIO Mocha adapter accepts a Mocha without chokidar 3.

exceptions.reason: WebdriverIO 9 requires deepmerge-ts 7. The package is used only by desktop test configuration with repository-controlled objects.
exceptions.upgrade: Remove after WebdriverIO accepts deepmerge-ts 8 or the desktop test stack moves to a fixed release.

exceptions.reason: The latest extract-zip release remains affected and is only used by WebdriverIO browser tooling against trusted downloads.
exceptions.upgrade: Remove when extract-zip publishes a patched release and WebdriverIO resolves it.

exceptions.reason: Mocha 10 pins serialize-javascript 6. It is used only by the desktop test runner with repository-controlled values.
exceptions.upgrade: Remove after the WebdriverIO Mocha adapter accepts serialize-javascript 7.1.1 or newer.

exceptions.reason: Only the 6.x line is patched, and get-uri (via WebdriverIO's browser downloader) requires basic-ftp 5. Desktop test tooling only; it never lists an attacker-controlled FTP directory.
exceptions.upgrade: Remove when get-uri accepts basic-ftp 6.2.1 or newer and WebdriverIO resolves it.

exceptions.reason: Wrangler exact-pins miniflare, which exact-pins undici 7.29.0. Local Workers tooling only; nothing it runs ships in a published package or site bundle. The other undici copies are patched.
exceptions.upgrade: Remove when the root wrangler pin moves to 4.147.0 or newer (miniflare with undici 7.29.1), which clears the release-age gate on 2026-10-09.

exceptions.reason: tauri-plugin-updater (2.11.0 pinned; 2.12.0, 2.13.3 and 2.14.0 still require zip ^4) runs ZipArchive::extract only on the Windows updater payload, after its Ed25519 signature verified against the embedded production key, so an archive with a symlink entry (0368) must carry that signature. Windows compiles out the Unix permission and set-id handling (0367, 0369). A local writer of the updater's per-user temp directory already controls the installer it launches; these advisories add nothing there.
exceptions.upgrade: Remove when the updater resolves zip 9.0.0 or newer, carries verified fixes for these advisories, or stops extracting zip archives by taking the plain .exe payload.
